messages:
alex: Quick sync — need a compact DP triage + ownership flow. Yesterday's weekly pulse exposed repeat blockers and unclear owners. Thoughts?

jordan: Proposal: bot creates a 'DP-pulse' ticket with tags (partner, surface, severity). Default assign: DP owner if set, else PM for non-sev, oncall for sev>=2.

maya: Strong +1. If DP owner exists we should set them as default and CC CS. Cuts churn.

sophia: For sev classifications: Sev2 = partner production impact, data integrity, security. SLA: 8h ack, 48h mitigation plan. Agree?

alex: Yes. Also call out 'feature feedback' vs 'production issue' in the ticket template so triage path is explicit.

tanvi: For feature asks, let's produce a weekly partner synthesis: Top 5 items, one prioritized request, suggested acceptance criteria, and partner impact note.

jordan: Add a public rubric so partners know what counts as 'in-scope'. PMs maintain it.

maya: Rubric draft idea: impact (low/med/high), effort (T-shirt or 1-5), risk (low/med/high). If impact=high && effort<=3 -> target next sprint.

sophia: I'll own the rubric doc and put examples (e.g., embeddings quality, latency regression).

alex: Automations: 1) pulse -> bot creates ticket with tags; 2) if DP owner exists -> assign; else -> oncall if sev>=2 else PM.

oncall-bot: Automated: Created ticket PROD-DP-9812 for partner "MedBridge" severity:2 surface:embeddings. https://jira.example.com/browse/PROD-DP-9812

jordan: If oncall picks it up, require a triage note within 4h with next steps. If requires dev work, convert to sprint issue and notify partner.

tanvi: I'll draft the weekly synthesis template and include a short script so PMs can copy pastable notes into partner-facing updates.

maya: After we ship a fix, send a tiny 2-question check: (1) Did this resolve your problem? (yes/no), (2) Acceptable outcome? (yes/no) + optional comment. CS will run this.

sophia: We'll log survey responses back to the ticket and the partner's feedback timeline.

alex: Launch criteria reminder for DP-driven features: acceptance criteria defined (rubric), partner demo, perf guardrails, rollback/fallback plan, and CS signoff.

jordan: Perf guardrails: latency regression <10% on DP traffic; if exceeded, gate rollback.

tanvi: Who maintains partner contact matrix (owner + backup)? We need explicit backups.

maya: I'll update the matrix today and tag backups in the sheet.

alex: Actions: @sophia write rubric draft by EOD Fri; @maya update partner matrix today; @tanvi create weekly synthesis template; @jordan add bot rule; alex to write 1-page oncall triage runbook.

jordan: I'll add the bot rule and example mappings to the product board.

sophia: Rubric draft uploaded: https://docs.internal/redwood/dp_rubric_v1 (examples incoming).

alex: Let's reconvene Wed 10am. If urgent DP blockers arrive earlier, tag thread and ping oncall. :thumbsup:

tanvi: ack :raised_hands: Thanks everyone.

maya: thanks \- updating matrix now.

oncall-bot: Reminder created: DP triage sync Wed 10:00 (invite sent).
